methodology.screenshot: viewport only, after waiting for elements intersecting both viewport axes; no scrolling
methodology.resourceBytes: PerformanceResourceTiming transferSize (network bytes including headers), encodedBodySize, decodedBodySize; initial navigation transfer and image/script resource subsets reported separately
